mapper.sql: AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM workspace_members actor WHERE actor.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND actor.member_id = #{memberId} AND actor.status = 0 AND (actor.role = 70 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_members mine WHERE mine.project_id = p.project_id AND mine.workspace_member_id = actor.workspace_member_id AND mine.role = 50 AND mine.status = 0)))

SELECT 1 AS "reportCategory", pr.project_report_id AS "reportId", pr.project_id AS "projectId", '프로젝트 보고서' AS "reportTypeName", p.subject AS "projectName", '-' AS "taskName", pr.title AS "reportTitle", md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(pr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", pr.created AS "sortDate", CASE p.status WHEN 0 THEN '예정' WHEN 1 THEN '진행 중' ELSE '완료' END AS "stageName", pr.progress AS "progress", CASE WHEN rr.status IN (1, 2) THEN rr.status WHEN rr.viewed IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE -1 END AS "reviewStatus" FROM project_reports pr JOIN projects p ON pr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON pr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.project_report_id = pr.project_report_id AND r2.category = 1 ) WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL
UNION ALL
SELECT 2 AS "reportCategory", tr.team_report_id AS "reportId", tr.project_id AS "projectId", '업무 보고서' AS "reportTypeName", p.subject AS "projectName", t.title AS "taskName", tr.title AS "reportTitle", md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(tr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", tr.created AS "sortDate", TO_CHAR(t.task_level) || ' 단계' AS "stageName", tr.progress AS "progress", CASE WHEN rr.status IN (1, 2) THEN rr.status WHEN rr.viewed IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE -1 END AS "reviewStatus" FROM team_reports tr JOIN tasks t ON tr.task_id = t.task_id AND tr.project_id = t.project_id JOIN projects p ON tr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON tr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND r2.category = 2 ) WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND tr.deleted IS NULL

sql.if: AND ( LOWER(R."projectName") LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(R."taskName") LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(R."reportTitle") LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' OR LOWER(R."authorName") LIKE '%' || LOWER(#{keyword}) || '%' )

choose.when: SELECT pr.project_report_id AS "reportId", rr.report_id AS "reviewId", 1 AS "reportCategory", pr.project_id AS "projectId", pr.project_member_id AS "projectMemberId", '프로젝트 보고서' AS "reportTypeName", p.subject AS "projectName", '-' AS "taskName", pr.title AS "reportTitle", pr.content AS "content", md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(pr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", CASE p.status WHEN 0 THEN '예정' WHEN 1 THEN '진행 중' ELSE '완료' END AS "stageName", pr.progress AS "progress", rr.review AS "reviewComment", rr.reject AS "rejectReason", TO_CHAR(rr.reviewed, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "reviewedDate", CASE WHEN rr.status IN (1, 2) THEN rr.status WHEN rr.viewed IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE -1 END AS "reviewStatus" FROM project_reports pr JOIN projects p ON pr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON pr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.project_report_id = pr.project_report_id AND r2.category = 1 ) WHERE pr.project_report_id = #{reportId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL
choose.otherwise: SELECT tr.team_report_id AS "reportId", rr.report_id AS "reviewId", 2 AS "reportCategory", tr.project_id AS "projectId", tr.task_id AS "taskId", tr.project_member_id AS "projectMemberId", '업무 보고서' AS "reportTypeName", p.subject AS "projectName", t.title AS "taskName", tr.title AS "reportTitle", tr.content AS "content", md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(tr.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "createdDate", TO_CHAR(t.task_level) || ' 단계' AS "stageName", tr.progress AS "progress", rr.review AS "reviewComment", rr.reject AS "rejectReason", TO_CHAR(rr.reviewed, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS "reviewedDate", CASE WHEN rr.status IN (1, 2) THEN rr.status WHEN rr.viewed IS NOT NULL THEN 0 ELSE -1 END AS "reviewStatus" FROM team_reports tr JOIN tasks t ON tr.task_id = t.task_id AND tr.project_id = t.project_id JOIN projects p ON tr.project_id = p.project_id JOIN project_members pm ON tr.project_member_id = pm.project_member_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN member_details md ON wm.member_id = md.member_id LEFT JOIN report_reviews rr ON rr.report_id = ( SELECT MAX(r2.report_id) FROM report_reviews r2 WHERE r2.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND r2.category = 2 ) WHERE tr.team_report_id = #{reportId} AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND t.deleted IS NULL AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL

mapper.update: MERGE INTO project_members pm USING ( SELECT p.project_id, wm.workspace_member_id FROM projects p JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_id = p.workspace_id AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND wm.role = 70 AND wm.status = 0 ) src ON (pm.project_id = src.project_id AND pm.workspace_member_id = src.workspace_member_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET pm.status = 0, pm.role = 70, pm."LEFT" = NULL, pm.updated = SYSDATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (project_member_id, project_id, workspace_member_id, role, status, joined) VALUES (seq_project_members.NEXTVAL, src.project_id, src.workspace_member_id, 70, 0, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT pm.project_member_id FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_members authorPm JOIN workspace_members authorWm ON authorPm.workspace_member_id = authorWm.workspace_member_id WHERE authorPm.project_member_id = #{authorProjectMemberId} AND authorWm.member_id = #{memberId}) AND (wm.role = 70 OR pm.role = 50) ORDER BY pm.role DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROW ONLY

choose.otherwise: SELECT team_report_id FROM team_reports WHERE team_report_id = #{reportId} AND project_id = #{projectId} AND deleted IS NULL FOR UPDATE

choose.when: INSERT INTO report_reviews (report_id, project_report_id, project_member_id, status, viewed, category) SELECT seq_report_reviews.NEXTVAL, #{reportId}, #{reviewerProjectMemberId}, 0, SYSDATE, 1 FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews WHERE project_report_id = #{reportId} AND category = 1)
choose.otherwise: INSERT INTO report_reviews (report_id, team_report_id, project_member_id, status, viewed, category) SELECT seq_report_reviews.NEXTVAL, #{reportId}, #{reviewerProjectMemberId}, 0, SYSDATE, 2 FROM dual WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews WHERE team_report_id = #{reportId} AND category = 2)

mapper.update: UPDATE report_reviews SET viewed = SYSDATE WHERE report_id = #{reviewId} AND status = 0 AND viewed IS NULL

UPDATE report_reviews SET status = #{reviewStatus}, review = #{reviewComment, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, reject = #{rejectReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, project_member_id = #{reviewerProjectMemberId}, reviewed = SYSDATE WHERE report_id = #{reviewId} AND status = 0 AND viewed IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM project_members pm JOIN workspace_members wm ON pm.workspace_member_id = wm.workspace_member_id JOIN projects p ON pm.project_id = p.project_id WHERE pm.project_member_id = #{reviewerProjectMemberId} AND pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL AND pm.status = 0 AND wm.status = 0 AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM project_members authorPm JOIN workspace_members authorWm ON authorPm.workspace_member_id = authorWm.workspace_member_id WHERE authorPm.project_member_id = #{authorProjectMemberId} AND authorWm.member_id = #{memberId}) AND (wm.role = 70 OR pm.role = 50) )
mapper.select: SELECT project_id FROM projects WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND deleted IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE tasks t SET progress = (SELECT LEAST(100, NVL(SUM(tr.progress), 0)) FROM team_reports tr WHERE tr.task_id = t.task_id AND tr.project_id = t.project_id AND tr.deleted IS NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM report_reviews rr WHERE rr.team_report_id = tr.team_report_id AND rr.category = 2 AND rr.status = 1) ), updated = SYSDATE WHERE t.task_id = #{taskId} AND t.project_id = #{projectId} AND t.deleted IS NULL

UPDATE projects p SET progress = (SELECT ROUND(NVL(AVG(t.progress), 0), 2) FROM tasks t WHERE t.project_id = p.project_id AND t.deleted IS NULL ), updated = SYSDATE WHERE p.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.deleted IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN R."reviewStatus" = -1 THEN 1 END) AS "uncheckedCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN R."reviewStatus" = 0 THEN 1 END) AS "pendingCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN R."reviewStatus" = 1 THEN 1 END) AS "approvedCount", COUNT(CASE WHEN R."reviewStatus" = 2 THEN 1 END) AS "rejectedCount" FROM () R
mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_project_reports.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO project_reports(project_report_id, project_id, project_member_id, title, content, progress, status, report_date, created) SELECT #{reportId}, #{projectId}, #{projectMemberId}, #{reportTitle}, #{content}, #{progress}, 0, SYSDATE, SYSDATE FROM project_members pm WHERE pm.project_member_id = #{projectMemberId} AND pm.role >= 50 AND pm.project_id = #{projectId} AND pm.status = 0

INSERT INTO report_files(report_file_id, project_report_id, original_name, stored_name, path, file_size, uploaded) SELECT seq_report_files.NEXTVAL, pr.project_report_id, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{path}, #{fileSize}, SYSDATE FROM project_reports pr WHERE pr.project_report_id = #{projectReportId} AND pr.project_member_id = #{projectMemberId}
mapper.select: SELECT p.project_id AS "projectId", p.subject AS "projectName", pm.project_member_id AS "projectMemberId" FROM projects p JOIN project_members pm ON pm.project_id = p.project_id JOIN workspace_members wm ON wm.workspace_member_id = pm.workspace_member_id JOIN workspace_domains wd ON wd.workspace_id = p.workspace_id WHERE wd.domain_key = #{domainKey} AND wd.active = 'Y' AND wm.member_id = #{memberId} AND wm.status = 0 AND pm.status = 0 AND pm.role >= 50 AND p.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY p.subject
